name: kept-hearth
unmodelled: assumed_enemy_element names the element of an enemy file that has none: the reference enemies carry no tags, so Fire is assumed unless the file says otherwise
The file's authored chain Wood, Fire, Earth and ward phase Metal are what the build runs before it has read anything, and all it has with turning_phase removed
One Ring (Redirect) is folded into layers[0]: one bought element line counted for all five
Ring's Weakest is 45 of the 75 in each art's x: lowest purity 30 at 1.5 points each. It reads the root at compile time
Slot 6, the escape art Cold Road, is not in the file: the calculator has no escape
Insult (the Turned Ring's node) reads a negative pass_tag on the chain's middle tag. No reference ward has one, so it is untested
The harmony cost (x0.60) on auxiliary arts acts on technique bonuses outside the fight
